title: in the Base overlays intro, say that an entry with "reverted too" reverts more than one file

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-183633-38ab, project ork, item S594:

in the Base overlays intro, say that an entry with "reverted too" reverts more than one file

Evidence: the intro says "with only that file reverted", which no longer holds for closure entries after S594
